CustomField.description: Per AC-11, the quantity the source Asset had at the moment a Renewal quote line was created. Amendment lines already get this from the standard StartQuantity field, but Revenue Cloud's own validation blocks StartQuantity from holding a non-zero value on any line whose action is Renew, so Renewal lines need this separate custom field instead. Populated by QuoteLineItem_Stamp_Renewal_Original_Quantity.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The asset's quantity at the time this renewal line was created. Renewal-only equivalent of Start Quantity, which Revenue Cloud does not allow to be set on Renew action lines.
CustomField.label: Original Quantity
